verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is fundamentally a documented, programmable API (Python/TypeScript) with extensive first-party docs covering query methods, streaming, custom tools, permissions, hooks, sessions, structured outputs, and production hosting — clearly enabling AI-native users to drive it programmatically. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API stability/completeness beyond vendor docs, and community feedback notes some DX friction and harness limitations that slightly temper a perfect score.
